scope: The standing marble Newall Telescope Observatory at Penteli, its attached southern approach, and the historic refractor visible behind the open dome shutter.

originalReview.notes: The illustration controls the early instrument’s tapered multi-section tube, short finder, graduated rings, counterweight and equatorial mount. People and non-instrument background were excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla engraving has an independently matched 1870 publication. It informs the instrument. Written owner figures and original footprint measurements govern the modern enclosure.
